question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

The children enjoyed the ______ very much.
solution: The correct answer is "fair." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The reason for using the word **"fair"** in the sentence is to convey that the children had a good time at a fair or carnival. • A **"fair"** in this context refers to an event with various attractions, games, rides, and possibly food stalls. • It is a place of entertainment and amusement, and by using the word **"fair," **the sentence suggests a positive and enjoyable experience for the children. • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.** Correct sentence: *The children enjoyed the **fair**__ very much.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Feer: **to mark off land for plowing. (जुताई के लिए भूमि चिन्हित करना) • **Fear: **the feeling that you have when something dangerous, painful or frightening might happen. (भय, डर) • **Fere: **an archaic or poetic word that is used to refer to a spouse or a companion. (एक पुरातन या काव्यात्मक शब्द जिसका उपयोग जीवनसाथी या साथी को संदर्भित करने के लिए किया जाता है) 39:T153a, The correct answer is **"****dance attendance."**
